name: chat-success-listed-models
title: 聊天成功率看板只看在架模型
description: st-chat-success 看板只统计在架模型：后端上报 st_chat_model_listed 名单，看板按名单过滤
creator: claude

mobile_performance.reason: 只在 OTel 指标导出（每 15 秒、后台）时读进程内已缓存的模型目录与畅聊快照并上报一组 gauge；不改任何移动端页面、HTTP 接口或对话请求链路，不新增请求路径上的查库。Android/iOS 页面加载 P95 与接口 P95 不受影响，不填零或推测数值。看板侧改动只影响 Grafana 查询。

scope: Listed-model loader reading model catalog + free zone snapshots
integration_points: lib/engineering-telemetry-exporter.ts observable gauge (existing exporter, st_telemetry_failures self-monitoring)
Existing models.refresh_failed / free_zone.snapshot_failed logs cover the underlying snapshot reads
failure_paths: Telemetry disabled: loader never registered, no reads
Snapshot read throws: keep previous list silently (avoids a warn every 15s while DB is down); underlying read errors are already logged by models.refresh_failed / free_zone.snapshot_failed
Never loaded since boot: gauge exports nothing; dashboard shows no data for that environment until next successful load (≤15s normally)
Process restart: gauge disappears until first load; Prometheus 5m lookback covers the gap
logging_integration.correlation: Aggregate metric only; no per-request context.
logging_integration.redaction: Labels are platform enum, provider model id bounded by identity(), lane enum; no user or config secrets.
verification: vitest engineering-observability.test.ts (new cases: gauge exported with identity labels; previous list kept when refresh fails)
After TEST/production release: query st_chat_model_listed and compare with catalog/free_zone_models
